title: LSASS Memory Access via PowerShell on WORKSTATION5
summary: At 14:32:57 on WORKSTATION5, powershell.exe opened lsass.exe with memory-read access (0x1010), consistent with credential dumping via T1003.001. This occurred alongside sustained C2 beacon traffic from powershell.exe to external IP 10.10.10.5:80, which is outside the company's known network ranges. The user pgustavo (Domain user, lab) also launched whoami.exe from powershell, indicating reconnaissance. These behaviors form a coherent attack chain starting with the earlier ALERT-001 PowerShell C2 beacon.
